evidence:
Directly compared source.md and PRODUCT-INTENT.md: people-first project goals, phase/task structure, explicit owners and manager interventions address the user purpose; logs remain supporting evidence.
People: one person may own tasks across many projects; shared projects remain single records; assigned work differs from participation; project-wide issues are not misattributed to a selected person.
Work: completion requires current runner evidence, completed dependencies, required human approval and phase/project gates; missing owners/acceptance and future or stale evidence cannot become complete.
Closed B1: EVERY declared phase must complete; taskless and optional-only phases remain unknown and prevent project completion; required counterexample added.
Closed B2: review digest now includes plan id/version/at, task, current full criterion definitions and latest full testplan records. Review must postdate work and applicable testplan definitions; same-ID changed-acceptance counterexample added.
Interventions: concrete missing assignment/acceptance, blockers, failure, review and revalidation actions link to work and preserve person/project scope.
Acceptance requires Python/JS parity, forged-import rejection, real browser person/goal/phase/task/intervention path, keyboard/390px and actual local fail-pass-revalidation evidence.
Design approval only: public synthetic examples, declared imported evidence, real local subprocess execution and deferred automatic multi-PC collection remain distinct. Implementation and operational completion require separate evidence.
